title: Hatsune Miku — Brand New Wonderland〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
The sun's shining and smiling♪
And I'm feelin' super duper good♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
But I'd feel even happier if Tsukasa and the others came to visit...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But they're about to start a new “term”...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, and they're becoming “freelancers”!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're gonna spread their wings and soar faaar away from Phoenix Wonderland to study in lots of other places☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wonder what sorts of places they'll go to put on shows? Hehehe, I'm so excited for them♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Soar...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehehe! I just had an idea♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, listen!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, it's Miku!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What's got you so flustered?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. I have an idea.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What I thought was...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just like Tsukasa and everyone, we should all soar faaar away from SEKAI☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Soar away from SEKAI?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup! That way we can learn a lot more about shows☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That sounds very fun, Miku. But, I don't think it's possible...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Whaaat?! Even if we ride the flying train?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I doubt it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Aww... Really?
That's sad...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hey, don't give up that easily!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Do you have an idea?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I know what it is. We can do a show in our dreams...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, Luka... That's not it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We can “soar” away from this stage and do a show somewhere new!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If we do that, I'm confident we can have a change of pace by putting on a different type of show than normal♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's a good point.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Everyone, would you be okay with trying to put on a different kind of show than normal since Miku came to us with her suggestion?

rows.Speaker: Luka, Rin & Len
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I would.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Y-You guys...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well then, I suppose the first thing to do is find a venue.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes! Let's all look for a place where it would be fun to put on a show♪

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I bet it would be fun to do a show while riding the horsies on the merry-go-round♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh yes, it would.
It would be a very cute show.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What about a show where the audience is looking down from the Ferris wheel?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa...! That sounds super fun!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm, but it would be hard for them to hear the cast's voices, so the actors would have to emphasize their body language and gestures♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What about you, Miku?
Did you see anywhere promising?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... Everywhere looks so good that I just can't choose.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe, that's not the worst predicament ever.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well then, what if we give up on choosing and come up with a show that involves moving from spot to spot?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Moving from spot to spot?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. The audience will move with us as the story progresses.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What's more, the lack of a barrier between the stage and the audience will make it a very impactful show.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's amazing!
They'll be watching the show right up close!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But, maybe Tsukasa and the others would prefer to be IN the show if they're that close...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I've got it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, KAITO, listen to this! The thing is...
